full_name: Elliott Colla | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2015–2016 Humanities William Bentinck-Smith Fellow Georgetown University
bio: Elliott Colla is an associate professor of Arabic and Islamic studies at Georgetown University with research interests in the links between social movements and literary production.
